chunks: And not the word of a poet. How little is it that you believe!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the claim that it is the word of a poet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a refutation of the poetic nature of the Quran by distinguishing it from the erratic, emotion-driven verses of poets, which are followed by the misguided. It underscores the divine origin of the Quran by highlighting the minimal faith of those who accept it merely as literary art rather than divine truth. This distinction reinforces the Quran's role as a clear, authoritative guide rather than a work of artistic expression.
